name: MACD and SAR
summary: This EA combines MACD and Parabolic SAR indicators to identify trend-following trade opportunities. It enters trades when both indicators confirm the same trend direction, using MACD for momentum confirmation and SAR for trend direction and trailing stops. The dual-indicator approach aims to filter out false signals by requiring confluence from both momentum and trend indicators.
summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和抛物线SAR指标来识别趋势跟踪交易机会。当两个指标确认相同的趋势方向时入场，使用MACD确认动量，SAR确认趋势方向和跟踪止损。双重指标过滤方法旨在通过要求动量和趋势指标的共振来减少虚假信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用MACD和抛物线SAR的双重指标趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：MACD主线与信号线交叉确认动量方向，同时SAR点位确认趋势方向一致时开仓。出场条件可能依赖SAR的反转信号作为跟踪止损，或MACD反向交叉作为平仓信号。仓位管理方面，典型的MQ5 EA会使用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，可能设有固定止损止盈，但具体取决于参数设置。该策略的优势在于双指标共振过滤假信号，但劣势是在震荡行情中SAR频繁反转会产生较多亏损交易，且MACD作为滞后指标可能导致入场较晚。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-indicator trend-following strategy combining MACD and Parabolic SAR. Entry conditions require MACD main line crossing its signal line to confirm momentum direction, while Parabolic SAR dots must align with the same trend direction for trade confirmation. Exit conditions likely rely on SAR reversal dots as trailing stops, or MACD reverse crossover as a close signal. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or account-equity-proportional lot calculation in standard MQ5 EAs. Money management may include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels depending on parameter configuration. The strategy benefits from dual-indicator confluence filtering false signals, but suffers in ranging markets where SAR frequently reverses generating multiple losing trades, and MACD as a lagging indicator may cause late entries.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, martingale base quantity

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

pros: 双指标共振过滤有效减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
SAR提供动态跟踪止损机制，能较好保护盈利
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数含义直观便于优化
趋势行情中表现优秀，能捕捉较大趋势波段
pros_en: Dual-indicator confluence effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
SAR provides dynamic trailing stop mechanism for better profit protection
Clear and intuitive strategy logic with well-understood parameters for optimization
Excellent performance in trending markets, capable of capturing large trend swings
cons: MACD滞后性导致入场偏晚，可能错过趋势初期最佳价位
SAR在震荡行情中频繁反转产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分趋势行情和震荡行情
典型实现缺少高级资金管理如动态仓位或风险百分比控制
cons_en: MACD lagging nature causes late entries, potentially missing optimal prices at trend start
SAR frequently reverses in ranging markets generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
Lacks market regime detection to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Typical implementation lacks advanced money management like dynamic position sizing or risk percentage control
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR）在震荡行情中自动暂停交易
加入动态仓位管理基于账户风险百分比而非固定手数
增加时间过滤和点差过滤避免不利时段和高成本交易
improvements_en: Add market regime filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to automatically pause trading in ranging conditions
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots
Add time filter and spread filter to avoid unfavorable trading sessions and high-cost executions

risk_points: 缺乏市场状态识别可能在震荡市中连续亏损
默认止损止盈可能为0，依赖指标反转出场存在较大滑点风险
SAR加速因子参数不当可能导致止损过紧或过松
risk_points_en: Lacks market regime detection which may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Default SL/TP may be zero, relying on indicator reversal for exit introduces significant slippage risk
Improper SAR acceleration factor settings may cause stops that are too tight or too loose
